prompt: Slow, perfectly steady cinematic dolly shot moving straight forward through a dark minimalist museum room with deep green-black plaster walls and a dark polished stone floor, toward a tall narrow open doorway at the centre of the far wall. Through the doorway glows warm ivory daylight and a calm sea horizon line. Sheets of old blank paper and empty archival folders hang from thin bronze threads from the ceiling on both sides, swaying very gently, backlit. Fine dust motes float in the warm light beam that spills across the floor. The camera glides forward the whole time, the doorway grows until its warm light fills the entire frame at the end. No people, no text, no writing, no symbols. Colour palette: charcoal, deep green, aged bronze, ivory. Soft volumetric light, shallow haze, 35mm anamorphic film look, elegant, contemplative, architectural.
